annotations.text:
Session flow: Today → Start session → Active session (weight sets, rest timer) → Timed set (plank) → session summary.
On Today, Accept or Keep each progression suggestion, then try Skip, Rest and Swap.
Plan tab: Routine cycle (tap a slot to swap it in) and Edit group (add or remove sets, toggle warm-up, link a superset).

Visual system: near-black #0e0f11 ground, one lime accent #c8f03c for the primary action and progress, amber for warm-up and countdown, red only for missed or skipped.
IBM Plex Sans for UI, IBM Plex Mono for every number. Min hit target 44 px. No status bar drawn; the real one sits on top.
